## 🎯 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. *I'm always frustrated when...*

## 💡 Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it should work in the retail/restaurant ERP environment.

## 🔄 Workflow Impact

Explain how this feature impacts cashiers, managers, kitchen staff, accountants, or delivery riders.

## 🛠️ Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context

Add any mockups, wireframes, or reference screenshots for how the UI/UX should look in Flutter.
